findings.quote: Otherwise the audit record names an action and no cause, and the reviewer rebuilds the intent from chat history.
Two grants cover an engineer holding an incident and a maintenance window at the same time.
A permission that travels further than the incident that justified it stops being a permission.
Every emergency door becomes an ordinary door once enough people know where it is.
The shutter reads the active grant table every 15 seconds and closes each grant whose expiry has passed.
Each region is enabled behind its own drawbridge, and no two drawbridges open in the same week.
